chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

play.action: four-frame one-shot pressure. Draw exactly one isolated horizontal pressure line spanning about 60 percent of the slot width. Frame 1 enters thin near the top edge; frames 2 and 3 settle slightly downward while the shallow central sag deepens and the thin dull-red lower rim brightens; frame 4 holds at the lowest point near the upper fifth. No second line, hand, chains, slab, wall, face, eye, particles, impact, or scenery. At least 90 percent of every frame stays empty.

style: minimal abstract pressure effect matching the accepted base image; one isolated charcoal-black horizontal line with a thin dull-red lower rim, clean tapered ends, no interior detail, no pixel art, no palette reduction
